newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - October 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - October 15.

text.p: The following stories were reported in Tuesday's Daily Variety:
NEW YORK - Savoy Pictures Entertainment chairman Victor Kaufman will join Silver King Communications when Silver King buys Savoy.
NEW YORK - The legal attack of Seagram Co Ltd unit MCA on Viacom Inc's right to launch its cable network TV Land goes to trial in Delaware on Tuesday, barring a last minute settlement.
HOLLYWOOD - Walt Disney Co has hired John Cywinski, who served as vice president of U.S. marketing for Burger King Corp, as marketing president for Buena Vista Pictures Motion Pictures Group.
